assertion_policy: Every frozen checker and its imports run in a fresh -I -B Python subprocess, with PYTHONOPTIMIZE removed, sys.flags.optimize==0, __debug__ true, a false-assertion probe, and compile(..., optimize=0). Frozen scripts contain no nested launcher or dynamic loader; all assertions stay enabled even when the wrapper runs under -O, -OO, or inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE.
clean_replay: Package bytes copied into a fresh temporary directory; every stored checker output removed before execution. No excluded-original or source-tree fallback.

comparison_policy.exact_euler_independent: stdout and generated result bytes identical to accepted fixtures
comparison_policy.reverse: Every nonfloating result field exact; sole floating error finite in [0,1e-12]. Current-platform byte equality reported separately.

finite_regression_scope: Exact script reports 16300 labelled cases; reverse reports 8300 labelled cases with one floating diagnostic; Euler reports five symbolic identities; independent script checks divisor/log identities through n=2000, rational HL factors, displaced Euler algebra, and an admissible parameter example. Counts overlap; do not sum as independent theorem evidence.
historical_external_byte_checks: Excluded PDF, source text, and datasets are not fetched or replayed.
